welcome:
Welcome to the Bash CLI Playground.
Simulated environment with nginx access logs, configs, and scripts.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check how many lines are in the access log.
Extract just the IP addresses from the log (field 1).
Now find the top 10 IPs by request count.
steps.expect: awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
steps.hint: Try: awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10

steps.instruction: Find which URLs are returning 500 errors.
steps.hint: Try: awk '$9 == 500 {print $7}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

steps.instruction: Check the HTTP status code distribution.
steps.hint: Try: awk '{print $9}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

steps.instruction: Find the IPs that are generating the most 500 errors.
steps.expect: awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5
steps.hint: Try: awk '$9 == 500 {print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5

steps.instruction: Check the request rate per hour from the timestamps.
steps.hint: Try: awk '{print $4}' access.log | cut -d: -f2 | sort | uniq -c

steps.instruction: Check what's in the current scripts directory.
Look at the current deploy.sh to understand the existing pattern.
Check which environment variables are set.
Test if the APP_ENV variable is set correctly.
Validate the config file syntax before deploying.
Run the deploy script in dry-run mode.

commands.cat deploy.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_NAME="api-server"
VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
ENV=${APP_ENV:-staging}
DRY_RUN=false

[[ "${1:-}" == "--dry-run" ]] && DRY_RUN=true

log() { echo "[$(date -u +%FT%TZ)] $1"; }

log "Deploying $APP_NAME v$VERSION to $ENV"

if $DRY_RUN; then
  log "DRY RUN — no changes will be made"
  log "Would build: docker build -t myregistry/$APP_NAME:$VERSION ."
  log "Would push:  docker push myregistry/$APP_NAME:$VERSION"
  log "Would deploy to $ENV cluster"
  exit 0
fi

log "Building image..."
log "Pushing to registry..."
log "Rolling out to $ENV..."
log "Deployment complete: $APP_NAME v$VERSION on $ENV"
